narr: Another round of storms with heavy rainfall moved into the region ahead of a cold front from the early morning through the early afternoon hours. The most notable flooding occurred at Roaring River State Park, where over three inches of rain caused the Roaring River to rise over 6 feet within a two-hour period. Evacuations were conducted with over 30 people moved from the campground near the river. Other reports of flooding were received along and south of interstate 44 where numerous low water crossings flooded. Most of the flood reports were received from areas where over two inches of rain fell during this event.

Multiple people camping on a gravel bar near Farm Road 2265 were rescued as Roaring River rose rapidly due to heavy rainfall. All individuals were rescued safely.

Heavy rain fell over Roaring River State Park causing Roaring River to flood campgrounds 2, 3 and the lower loop of campground 1. Thirty two campers were evacuated prior to the peak flooding. Minor damage to the park was reported as a result of the fast moving water.
